CTSDND35.ActorSheetVisualThemeHint: Rounded cards or angled / hex-style panels on the character sheet (client setting).
CTSDND35.GroupFilterHint: Show actors that have a matching Faction item or legacy groups text.
CTSDND35.FactionPresetsHint: One name per line. Used as suggestions in the Actors sidebar filter dropdown.
CTSDND35.DirectoryTypeToolbarsHint: Show compact wrapped filter chips inside the Scenes, Actors, Items, and Macros sidebar panels (instead of extra sidebar tab buttons). Turn off for a stock Foundry directory header.
CTSDND35.SceneFilterNavHint: Show only scenes placed on the navigation bar
CTSDND35.SceneFilterNonNavHint: Show only scenes not on the navigation bar
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshSheets: Apply to all actors & refresh sheets
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshSheetsHint: GM only: saves this faction from the form (even if you have not closed the sheet), updates every matching faction item on all world actors (same compendium/source link, or same name), syncs group strings for everyone, then redraws open CTS sheets. Same display name on different factions will all be updated.
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshNeedsGM: Only a GM can push faction changes to all actors.
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshSheetsDone: Updated {embeddedUpdated} other matching faction item(s); synced groups on all {actorsTotal} actors; redrew {sheetsRedrawn} open sheet(s).
CTSDND35.MerchantWalletEquivHint: Total coin value expressed in gold pieces
CTSDND35.MerchantEmptyStock: No goods in stock. Add weapons, armor, equipment, or consumables on this NPC's Inventory tab.
CTSDND35.MerchantNothingToSell: Nothing eligible to sell (weapons, armor, equipment, consumables only).
CTSDND35.MerchantFootnote: Prices use each item's Price field (gp), merchant multipliers below, and Trade & factions percent modifiers on buyer and seller.
CTSDND35.MerchantHint: Put shop stock on this NPC like any inventory. Set quantity and Price (gp) per item. Open the shop as whichever PC is selected or assigned.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorInvalidActor: That actor is missing or invalid.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorNotEnabled: Turn on "This NPC is a merchant" above and save the sheet.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorNoBuyer: Select a PC token on the canvas or assign a player character to use as the buyer.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorNoPermission: You cannot trade for that character.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorBadItem: That item cannot be traded at this shop.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorZeroPrice: That transaction has no valid price.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorMerchantFunds: The merchant does not have enough coin on hand.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorPurchaseOnly: This merchant does not purchase goods from characters.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorTimeout: Timed out waiting for the GM.
